reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x00408460 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/misc/00408460-FallLanding.cpp at sha256 a07b2290aeff70cece8f18af366208d045544fc13c9e2f0be0b905d15c12d01a (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t FallLanding(float param_1);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

retail_function.name: FallLanding
retail_function.summary: Twenty-seven blocks 0x408460-0x408713: step/velocity integration over the human_player fields at +0x66C/+0x664/+0x668/+0x1B8..+0x1C4, AI_UpdatePatrol_24 at 0x4085DC, Human_GetLimbDamageRecord(0x00489E10) at 0x40861C, Human_HitDamage at 0x408635, sprintf("player_fall_3") at 0x4086AB, SoundSys_SetMasterVolume_7, DynObj_UpdateDynTree_4 and AI_EventBroadcast.

candidate_function.summary: Twenty-seven blocks 0x408460-0x408713: step/velocity integration over the human_player fields at +0x66C/+0x664/+0x668/+0x1B8..+0x1C4, AI_UpdatePatrol_24 at 0x4085DC, Human_GetLimbDamageRecord(0x00489E10) at 0x40861C, Human_HitDamage at 0x408635, sprintf("player_fall_3") at 0x4086AB, SoundSys_SetMasterVolume_7, DynObj_UpdateDynTree_4 and AI_EventBroadcast.

divergences: Call target at the 0x00489E10 site is FX_FragmentSimulate_14, not the retail Human_GetLimbDamageRecord.
Candidate return type/signature disagree with BN (void*/int) and with the recorded int(float) signature.
candidate_comparison.statement: Divergences are listed above; by contract they keep the record at TRANSCRIBED or lower.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail entry 0x00408460 is recovered by all three tools; the address-bound implementation is scripts/GameNatives/misc/00408460-FallLanding.cpp (sha256 a07b2290aeff70cece8f18af366208d045544fc13c9e2f0be0b905d15c12d01a). Twenty-seven blocks 0x408460-0x408713: step/velocity integration over the human_player fields at +0x66C/+0x664/+0x668/+0x1B8..+0x1C4, AI_UpdatePatrol_24 at 0x4085DC, Human_GetLimbDamageRecord(0x00489E10) at 0x40861C, Human_HitDamage at 0x408635, sprintf("player_fall_3") at 0x4086AB, SoundSys_SetMasterVolume_7, DynObj_UpdateDynTree_4 and AI_EventBroadcast.

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: BN int32_t(float arg1) is a decompiler type for a pointer argument; the candidate header declares void FallLanding(void* human_player) but the file's exported signature is recorded as int FallLanding(float param_1). That mismatch (void* vs float, void vs int) is unresolved in the candidate itself.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: BN int32_t(float arg1) is a decompiler type for a pointer argument; the candidate header declares void FallLanding(void* human_player) but the file's exported signature is recorded as int FallLanding(float param_1). That mismatch (void* vs float, void vs int) is unresolved in the candidate itself.

checks.name: control_flow_shape
checks.detail: Retail CFG: Binary Ninja reports 27 block(s)/38 edge(s) at 0x00408460; radare2 recovers the identical 27 block(s)/38 edge(s) (score 1.0000); angr CFGFast recovers 34 block(s) with has_unresolved_jumps=False.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: Retail call sites are 0x004659B0, 0x00489E10 (Human_GetLimbDamageRecord), 0x00416D80 (Human_HitDamage), 0x004A53B3 (sprintf/Game_DataSymbolLoad), 0x004E6B00, 0x004C3440 and 0x00450CE0. The candidate calls an unbound FX_FragmentSimulate_14 at the 0x00489E10 site (its header admits the catalog alias is unconfirmed), so the damage-record call target is not the retail callee.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: Constants 0x5333BC/0x5333C4/0x5333C8/0x5333CC/0x5333D0/0x5333D8/0x5333E0/0x5333E4/0x5333E8/0x5333EC/0x5333F0 and 0x56E1F4; the sprintf format "player_fall_3" at 0x00538D3C.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: The typed player_state+offset accesses use the retail offsets (0x664/0x668/0x66C, 0x1B8..0x1C4, 0x78..0x94); the earlier byte-wise damage-state copies are reconstructed with typed stores.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: Void in the candidate header; BN models int32_t. Neither the header nor the recorded signature agrees with the BN/retail return model.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.detail: The candidate keeps the fld/fmul/fadd/fchs/fcom sequences as float expressions with the same constants (0x5333BC..0x5333F0) and the same NaN-gated branch structure via IsOrderedNonzero.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t(float arg1)" at 0x00408460; radare2 recovers "fcn.00408460 (int32_t arg_5ch);". Both tools place the entry at 0x00408460 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int32_t FallLanding(float param_1);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.

binary_ninja.tool: Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 free; UI MCP server binaryninja_ui_mcp 0.1.0

limitations: No game process was executed; this review is static (live Binary Ninja, radare2 CFG, angr CFGFast) plus the candidate source.
The candidate is a hand-written reconstruction (56 normalized statements vs 88 in BN's pseudocode); its control flow matches block-for-block but at least one callee is not bound to the retail target.
